google_artemis.name: Google ARTEMIS
blocked_operations: GET /api/status (may start queue dispatcher and run pending tasks)
activation_requirements: A supported Python 3.12+ ARTEMIS host with its dependencies installed
An authorized Android device or emulator visible to that host through ADB
A verified zero-cost or explicitly approved model route for ARTEMIS; no paid Gemini route by default
A loopback-only local endpoint or an HTTPS reverse proxy with bearer authentication
A verified device selection and operator-approved mobile test scope
google_artemis.status_reason: No ARTEMIS daemon endpoint or ADB-authorized Android device has been verified from the Raawaa runtime.

arena_agent_mode.name: Arena Agent Mode
arena_agent_mode.supported_handoff: User-initiated Arena Agent Mode session connected to the selected Raawaa repository; GitHub issue/PR is the durable exchange channel.
activation_requirements: User connects only the intended repository through Arena's official GitHub connector
One bounded task per Agent Mode session
Task brief references a durable GitHub issue and explicit acceptance criteria
Arena submits a branch and pull request
Executive coordinator independently reviews exact diff and CI before integration
arena_agent_mode.status_reason: Official documentation confirms GitHub-connected sandboxed Agent Mode and PR workflow. No supported public API for automated Agent Mode dispatch was verified; published Terms prohibit programmatic/automated service access.
